project_context.product: AI-powered demand planning platform for fashion retailers

typography.setup_instruction: Inject Fontshare CDN link in index.html for Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi: <link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@900,800,700,500&f[]=satoshi@700,500,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Bento Grid (Mode A) - asymmetrical spans, wide gaps (gap-6 to gap-12)
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-[32px] for hero image wrappers

buttons.primary: bg-[#2563eb] text-white font-medium hover:bg-[#4f46e5] transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/25 px-6 py-3 rounded-full
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0a0a0a] border border-black/10 font-medium hover:bg-black/5 transition-all px-6 py-3 rounded-full

components.cards: Surface strategy: 'Grid Borders' or 'Tactile Neumorphism'. 1px solid border (border-black/10), soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm), solid white background to pop against #fafafa.
components.navbar: Crystal glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5. Sticky top-0 z-50.
components.icons: Use lucide-react (stroke-width 1.5) or @phosphor-icons/react for a premium look.

animation.general: Use framer-motion for smooth scroll-triggered reveal animations. (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} viewport={{ once: true }}).
animation.hover: Hover state transitions MUST explicitly define colors (e.g. hover:text-white) and use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-out'.

hero.description: Hero section 3D abstract element. Use as an offset image alongside the main headline or masked into an arched/pill shape.

feature_background.description: Background texture for the main Features Bento grid (use absolute positioning, object-cover, opacity-30).

how_it_works.description: Visual representation of inventory/warehouse for the How it Works execution phase.

trust_badges.description: Marshall logo (Apply grayscale, brightness-0, opacity-40 in CSS)
Coca Cola wall sign (Apply grayscale, brightness-0, opacity-40 in CSS)
Mercedes emblem (Apply grayscale, brightness-0, opacity-40 in CSS)

instructions_to_main_agent: NEVER USE PLACEHOLDER IMAGES. Always use the specific image URLs provided in the image_urls section.
Apply all fonts strictly! Add Fontshare CDN in the public index.html. Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Satoshi for body text.
Build a custom HTML/Tailwind layout for the marketing page matching route '/' for unauthenticated users.
Routing requirement: 'Login' CTA points to '/login', 'Start Free Trial' points to '/signup'.

Section Checklist: Navbar (Glassmorphic), Hero (with Hero image), Stats bar (4 stats), Features (8 features in a Bento Grid Mode A), Pricing (3 tiers, emphasize Professional), How It Works (4 steps + warehouse image), Testimonials (with portraits), Footer.
Testing: Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form elements).
Use framer-motion to add subtle fade-up animations to each major section.
Avoid standard Bootstrap/Tailwind blocky layouts. Break symmetry, use overlapping elements slightly, and ensure there's generous whitespace (p-12, py-32).
